rationale_bullets: Iamaleava returns as the retained face of the rebuild: 72.0 PFF/425 dropbacks (B10 +1 -> 73.0, ~p52 tape), 1,928 @ 64.4% with 13-7, PLUS the team-high 505 rushing yards, the 5-TD Penn State upset, and a November concussion played through.
The two-year career base is real: 2,930 @ 63.6%, 21-5 at Tennessee including a CFP trip.
The scheme bends toward him: 'James Madison used a lot of quarterback designed-runs' (P6); Chesney: 'he has a good grasp of the offense... he's not humble out there.'

The counters: 14th in B10 QB Rating; the Athlon scout's 'without his feet... I'm not sure he can sit in the pocket and carve you up'; and ZERO proven depth (all three backups transferred out; brother Madden + a Cal Poly import behind).
60, M: league-median tape + 5* physical ceiling + rush value + scheme fit, discounted for the rating floor and the empty room.
Knight arrives as the proven piece: 81.3 PFF/206 att at JMU (SBC -2 -> 79.3), 1,373 @ 6.6-6.9 including 110 yards on Oregon in the CFP - a 5'7 burst back with real volume.
The returners are credible rotation tape: Woods (72.0/63; 1,155 @ 5.6 at Idaho '23) + J. Thomas (72.9/81; 626 @ 6.3 at Cal '24); Lee (77.0/25 at ISU) adds depth. Berger (74.2/81) expired.
PS: production 'should at least double if not triple last year's'; P6 expects 'another three-man committee.'
60, M: a ~p68 adjusted workhorse plus two proven rotation backs behind a rebuilt line - the committee depth lifts it over Purdue's 48-class rebuild.
Another full restart - Gilmer (61.0/430) to Nebraska, Flores (63.0/226) to Virginia, Mokiao-Atimalala (62.4/294) expired - off a RECV p16 / #134-explosiveness season.

The imports bring speed and pedigree: Ellis (77.8 PFF/268 at JMU -> 76.8; 624 @ 17.3 - the best tape), Mizell (68.6/125 at Florida, SEC +6 -> 74.6; Top100, 4* transfer grade), Rowe (60.7/177 at SCar -> 66.7; 2025 4*; PS's 'top guy out of spring'), L. Smith (62.3/525 at SJSU -> 58.3; 6'4 at full volume), Morgan (Michigan).
The TE room is a four-import stack (Loftin/Phifer/Lodge/Amar) led by a blocking JMU TE; Matthews (58.0/291) is the returning slot vet.
P6: 'an upgraded unit'; PS: 'a more potent unit.'
52, M: weighted aggregate ~65 (~p45) with genuine speed adds but no proven P4 volume producer - graded between the restart floor and the upgrade case.
One returning starter - Brooks (65.1 PFF/696 -> 64.1), 'their best one' (P6) - and 'Pick Your Transfer at the other four spots.'

The imports have starts, not tape: J. Davis (48.6/572 at S. Alabama - 30 career starts, poor grade), the JMU All-SBC pair Sweazie (64.1/805) + Robell (65.1/627), Schmidt (69.5/37 at Boise - the '24 CFP starter on a 37-snap '25 sample), Osman (Harvard All-Ivy, FCS), Na'a, Indestad (50.3/194 at EMU, MAC -15 -> 35.3).
Returning depth: Yoon (59.2/743; Athlon bolds him at C vs PS's Robell), Armella (54.4/306; FSU pedigree).
The '25 gamble 'backfired and produced a below average unit' (P6): PBLK p36 / RBLK p28 - and this is a second consecutive all-transfer line.
42, M: projected-starter aggregate ~60 (~p32); more proven-start quantity than Purdue's 38-class line, less than Rutgers' anchored 50.

The fix targets the file's worst pass rush (PRSH p0; 22 sacks; 'the least disruptive defense in America' - P6): West (80.5 PFF/562 at JMU, SBC -6 -> 74.5; 7 sk, 14 TFL, Sun Belt FROY) + Gobaira (76.1/481 -> 70.1) + McCulloch (75.4/210 at Cal -> 76.4; 'California's best edge rusher').
The cost side: both starting DTs gone (G. Smith 75.4/517 expired; K. Williams to PSU) plus Taupaki (PSU) and A. Jones (Nebraska).

The interior is a projection: DeNgohe (64.0/160 at Rutgers -> 74.0; injury-shortened '25; JMU '24 with this staff), Ford (54.5/77; Top100 pedigree), Roy (OSU rFr, no tape), Fuimaono (56.8/209; Withdrawn STAYS), Walls (64.0/131 -> 74.0), Washington (67.2/93 at TT).
Context: Hitschler's JMU defense was national top-10 with 35 sacks.
56, M: real edge tape (70-76 adjusted) attached to an unproven interior - just under the Wake-60 shape.
Woods (61.7 PFF/414, B10 +16 -> 77.7) is the lone returning starter after Vaughns (65.9/600; 107 tackles) expired and Chisom (66.6/546) left for Oklahoma State.

The marquee add: Omosigho (72.1/297 at Oklahoma, SEC +14 -> 86.1) - a 4* transfer with 89 tackles and 9.5 TFL across two rotation years; 'a really commanding presence' (Chesney). LB caution: it's a 297-snap rotation sample with a heavy offset.
Spinogatti (77.2/463 at JMU, SBC -8 -> 69.2; 17 career starts) is the full-volume floor; Sacca (ND 2025 4*) is pedigree without tape; Pellot (56.1/181) develops.
LB caution rule shapes the grade: the two best adjusted numbers are offset-driven; the trustworthy piece is a solid SBC starter.
60, M: a genuine three-deep with pedigree, graded at the cautioned aggregate - between OSU's 64 and Rutgers' 54.

'The secondary is the unit's strength' (Athlon): Pleasant returns (72.2 PFF/609 -> 78.2) as 'arguably their top defender... all-league potential' (P6), with NB Jackson (69.2/493 -> 75.2; Withdrawn STAYS) and S Martin (60.6/750 -> 66.6; portal-return override - both prints return him).

Starter-grade imports: Johnson (68.9/802 at Utah -> 70.9 - a full-volume B12 starter; 'a phenomenal football player' - Chesney), Barksdale (73.1/782 at JMU -> 69.1; All-SBC, 27 starts), James (69.9/333 at ISU -> 71.9), Gilbert (69.6/288 at UConn).
The quiet loss: Jordan (72.0/553) to Auburn; Lawrence (58.4/717) expired; Clark/Benjamin/Threats out.
Lovett (46.1/63 at VT) is P6's projected CB2 but the tape says depth - flagged.
66, M: seven bodies at 66-78 adjusted, four at real volume - the deepest position on the roster, without an 80-class star.
